conditional_requirements.UAT: Functional or customer-facing behavior changes generally require appropriate functional validation.
conditional_requirements.Customer Approval: Apply when the change has customer-specific impact or the applicable process requires it.
conditional_requirements.Outage Details: Apply when service interruption or downtime is expected or possible.
conditional_requirements.Security Evidence: Apply when security controls or security-relevant components are changed.

hard_gates.conflict: An unresolved reported conflict blocks readiness.
hard_gates.missing_recovery: A credible recovery mechanism is required unless a documented exception is accepted.
